about: Jobs the app can ask Claude to do straight away, through the helper (apps/server). The app sends only the job's name; these words are what Claude follows.

find-ideas.label: looking for what to do next
find-ideas.prompt: The person has pressed Find ideas in the Toolkit. Follow .claude/skills/whats-next: read apps/toolkit/data/toolkit.json, context/ and every installed tool's data file, then add up to 5 new ideas to the ideas list in apps/toolkit/data/toolkit.json (never repeat a dismissed one). Connect nothing, send nothing, change nothing else.
